name: Break Sharptusk!
summary: Brave Windfeather sends you east from Red Cloud Mesa to face the raids on Mulgore. Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the Bristleback quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine, and his death could strike a hard blow against their attacks.

sections.title: A Home Won in Blood
sections.body: Red Cloud Mesa is home to young tauren learning the hunt and the ways of the Earth Mother. East of the mesa, Brambleblade Ravine lies in the hands of the Bristleback quilboar. They see the tauren as invaders taking sacred ground, and their skirmishes threaten the tribes trying to make a stable home in Mulgore.

sections.title: The Threat of Thornmantle
sections.body: The Bristleback attacks on Red Cloud Mesa follow the command of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. Deep in Brambleblade Ravine, he directs his warriors and geomancers against the Shu'halo from a fortified makeshift village. Brave Windfeather knows the raids will continue while Sharptusk lives. She sends you into the ravine to kill him and bring back his severed head as proof.

sections.title: The Lessons of the Hunt
sections.body: Brave Windfeather teaches that hunting an enemy who can hunt back tests more than skill. For young tauren and their allies, the hunt for Sharptusk demands courage, awareness, and discipline. His death brings justice for fallen kin and marks a hunter's readiness to travel across Mulgore's wider plains.

faq.answer: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the Bristleback quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine. His tribe stages raids and skirmishes against the tauren settlement on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Where can Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle be found?
faq.answer: Sharptusk Thornmantle lives deep in Brambleblade Ravine, east of Red Cloud Mesa. He directs his tribe from a makeshift village inside the thorn-covered canyon.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Break Sharptusk!?
faq.answer: Brave Windfeather offers the hunt for Sharptusk. The seasoned tauren warrior guards Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa and charges newcomers with proving their mettle against the Bristleback threat.

faq.q: Why do the Bristleback quilboar hate the tauren?
faq.answer: The Bristleback quilboar revere their demigod Agamaggan and defend the lands they claim. They see tauren settlements in Mulgore as trespass on their ancestral hunting grounds.

faq.q: What proof does Brave Windfeather demand?
faq.answer: Brave Windfeather demands Sharptusk Thornmantle's severed head. It proves the chief has fallen and warns the remaining Bristlebacks.

faq.q: What is the cultural significance of this hunt for young tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren maturity means understanding the balance between hunter and hunted. Windfeather teaches that facing a cunning enemy like Sharptusk shows young warriors the cost of mortal combat and the duty of defending their tribe.

angles.text: For a young tauren, killing Sharptusk Thornmantle is one of the final trials before leaving Camp Narache. It proves you are ready to defend the tribes from hostile neighbors.
As an ally of the Horde, you help steady Mulgore and secure peaceful lands for your new tauren brothers by killing Chief Sharptusk.
As a hunter, you face an early test: tracking prey with its own cunning, weapons, and intent to hunt you in return.
